origin.description: The user explicitly requires architectural choices, rejected options and reasons to survive, and requests useful harness practices be assimilated without flattening Projector into instructions.
Motivating integration evidence; not authority for Projector-specific design or claimed implementation.

payload.statement: For application behavior that needs runtime observation, run the affected scenario in an identifiable application test instance with owned setup and teardown, an allocated endpoint, fresh test state, and explicit host trust assumptions. Give the host agent access to required browser input, logs, metrics, traces and diagnostics using supported tools. Bind acceptance to the actual source/build/scenario/controller state, collection method and freshness, retain diagnostics on failure or unavailable collection, and keep outcome, operational status, currentness and assurance separate. Prefer a concrete application adapter over a generic provisioning framework. Browser evidence does not prove acoustic, device, learning, or other unobserved outcomes.
payload.title: Connect affected meaning to inspectable application behavior
